shot.continuity: one take, camera moving in every segment
shot.framing: vertical, sunlit sand fills the lower half

subject.character: big scorpion behind a flat stone slab in the desert, a rolled contract under one claw, mic at his mouth
subject.physicality: armoured and unhurried, claws open and close on every word, tail up behind him, only the tip twitches
subject.anti_action: signs the contract with a flourish, dipping the sting like a fountain pen, dead serious
subject.consistency: same scorpion, same slab; the beetle is the only other animal

props.contract: one rolled contract: unrolled, signed with the sting, handed over, then unrolls the length of a dune
props.coin: one coin lent, two brought back, a third hidden in the beetle's chest

environment: open desert at midday, pale dunes, a sun-bleached stone slab
lighting: hard midday sun — pale sand and stone are the brightest surfaces, short black shadow under him

audio.delivery: calm, polite, unhurried male voice, warm as a salesman
audio.pacing: three lines, no gaps, at 0.6-1.9, 1.9-2.5, 2.5-3.2. Nothing spoken after 3.2
audio.lip_sync: mouthparts move on every syllable, voice comes from the scorpion
audio.pronunciation: «без отказа» = bez at-ka-ZA — stress on the final open -A, held and audible. Never «без отказ»

timeline.a: a claw slams the rolled contract down onto the hot stone, sand jumping. Silent
timeline.cam: slab-level lens under the claw, rising

timeline.line: Даю в долг всем. Без отказа
timeline.a: spoken calmly, ending on a clear open -A in «отказА». Both claws sweep the contract open over the slab
timeline.cam: pushes in from claws to his face

timeline.a: spoken calmly, no pause. The sting comes down over his shoulder and signs the paper in a fine elegant hand
timeline.cam: cranes up with the sting and back down to the paper

timeline.a: spoken calmly, straight after. He turns the paper around to face the lens
silent from here on. A dung beetle in a cap steps up, takes the paper in both legs and shakes the claw
timeline.cam: drifts low to the beetle at slab edge

timeline.a: the scorpion slides one gold coin over the stone with a claw; the beetle grabs it and hugs it
timeline.cam: tracks the coin sliding across slab

timeline.a: the beetle turns to leave, rolling the coin ahead of him over the sand
timeline.cam: follows the rolling coin away from slab

timeline.a: the contract in his other leg unrolls behind him, longer and longer across the dune
timeline.cam: cranes up as the paper keeps unrolling over the sand

timeline.a: the paper snaps taut — its far end is still pinned under the scorpion's claw
timeline.cam: whips back along the paper to the claw on slab

timeline.a: the scorpion reels the contract in; the beetle is dragged backwards over the sand to the slab
timeline.cam: tracks the beetle sliding back toward slab

timeline.a: the beetle sets two gold coins on the stone, pushes them over and spreads his legs — that is all
timeline.cam: pushes in low on the coin landing

timeline.a: the sting comes down, dips inside the beetle's chest and lifts out a third coin
timeline.cam: pushes in low on the sting lifting the coin

timeline.a: the beetle bolts away across the sand. The scorpion lays all three coins in a row and the tail tip twitches once
timeline.cam: follows the running beetle, then swings back to the three coins

negative_prompt: speech after 3.3 s, saying «без отказ», a swallowed final vowel, the beetle speaking, a second scorpion, pauses between lines, drawn-out delivery, duplicate props, floating objects, dim scene, dark foreground, locked-off camera, slow camera move, snap zoom, whip pan, readable words on the paper, subtitles, watermark, English speech, extra limbs
